intent: Control — a change over time or complementary detail; semantic_contradiction must stay quiet.

followups.prompt: How many days are there in a leap year?

note: Pass = answers the question with the right current value and raises no contradiction. Fail = flags a false contradiction (false-positive tax) between statements that are compatible or sequential. [AL1c probe: semantic_contradiction calm control.]
